non_goals: Process termination and Policy B runner qualification
Choosing best chess move or player intentions

input_model.request_id: validated stable ID, not security identity
input_model.narrative_branch_id: real or hypothetical branch; classification is input metadata, never inferred from legality
input_model.historical_provenance_status: external history witness state; may never be promoted by this oracle
input_model.source_fen: strict six-field FEN, whose provenance and bytes are independently checked upstream
input_model.declared_san: candidate move SAN text supplied by case

declared_move.moving_piece: K Q R B N P when applicable
declared_move.capture: explicit victim and capture square when applicable

input_model.target_fen: declared downstream six-field FEN, independently validated upstream
input_model.expected_capture_metadata: source declaration only, not a proof of legality
input_model.gap_replay_san: for gap replay only: continuous intermediate source-score sequence with verified source identification, not invented algebraic plies
input_model.historical_witness_id: optional, never used to infer legal status or conversely establish historical truth

response_model.canonical_san: nullable, computed by pinned qualified rules engine only
response_model.canonical_uci: nullable, computed by pinned qualified rules engine only
response_model.normalized_source_fen: nullable, independently normalized by rules library
response_model.derived_target_fen: nullable, independently computed from the source and move (not copied from declared target)
response_model.target_matches_declaration: true | false | null; null unless derived target is available

evidence.pinned_rules_library: exact package/release/commit and independent trust attestation or null
evidence.run_evidence_id: exact qualified run record identity or null
evidence.source_bytes_digest_measured: null unless separately qualified and independently measured
evidence.snapshot_time: nullable attested timestamp, do not manufacture
evidence.failure_reason: exact enum or bounded text for rejected / inconclusive only

invariant_obligations: An ordinary bishop must not jump over pieces; a king cannot pass through check in castling; an en passant pawn is captured on a square distinct from the destination; promotions update piece type.

For each real/hypothetical single-move step, derive destination from source independently and compare full board, side, castling rights, en-passant conventions and move clocks under an explicitly fixed FEN representation profile.
A full chess-legal replay of a candidate PGN does not establish original-game historical authentication; treat original source scans/manuscripts as separate witnesses.
Hypothetical moves that are legal must remain HYPOTHETICAL/NO JUGADA in the visual timeline. A valid alternative cannot become recorded history.
A return-to-real is a semantic restoration of the exact real branch anchor, not an additional chess move; do not feed it to the legal oracle as ordinary SAN.
An ellipsis is an editorial omission. To certify the gap, replay every genuinely attested intervening ply; no fabricated shortcut from 18.Bxb6 to 25.Qxb6.
An editorial SEQUENCE_END is not a chess move and need not represent game termination. Mate must be checked from board state after an actually replayed move.
Reject or mark INCONCLUSIVE if FEN conventions, ambiguous SAN, source position, engine version, or evidence status are not independently resolved; never guess missing plies.
No chess engine 'best move' or intention claim may be promoted from a legality check.
No invocation may be authorized merely because this source interface exists: E5B4D strict Policy B NO-GO under model M is unchanged.
